rapport_notes: Warm and accommodating with a long-distance customer juggling a full-service pack-and-move; answered every logistical question patiently.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to ask during this call?' — asked immediately after quid pro quo, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'I don't wanna have to move a finger during this process... is that something that is realistic?' Rep: 'Yes, if you wanted to have a full packing, yes, we can be able to do that' — single reassurance, no further probing.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: No Save Your Ass lines were delivered; call ended after David said he'd shop around, without a rate-commit, window, or fairness check.

top_strength: Clear, patient walkthrough of full-service packing logistics for a long-distance move, adjusting the plan (partial vs. full packing) on the fly.
coaching_note: The customer's real concern ('I don't want to touch anything') got one reassurance and no second-layer follow-up — a natural spot to ask what specifically worries them about handing everything over.
